description: Describes sire information used in reproductive contexts.

sireIdentifiers.description: One or more unique scheme/identifier combinations for the sire.

sireOfficialName.description: Official herdbook name of the sire.

sireURI.description: URI to an AnimalCoreResource for the sire.

sirePrimaryBreed.description: ICAR Breed code for the sire referenced by the sireIdentifiers. If more than one sire is identified, do not specify the breed unless all sires have the same primary breed.
